blocks.heading: How to Actually Read a "Salary" Number

figures.label: Total Course Duration
figures.source: CA, BArch, and BTech all show a wide gap between entry pay and pay 5-7 years in. A course that starts modestly (architecture, hospitality) can still compound well if the field itself has a real growth curve.

figures.label: Relevant Experience Window
figures.source: CA, BArch, and BTech all show a wide gap between entry pay and pay 5-7 years in.

supporting: A viral "IIIT placement hits Rs 1.5 crore" headline describes one outlier offer, not what most graduates from that batch actually earned. Look for the average or median package, not the highest.

blocks.heading: Mistakes That Quietly Wreck the ROI

figures.label: Estimated Time Required
figures.source: A course you can actually get into, actually afford, and actually stay motivated through for 3-5 years usually out-earns a prestige pick you drop out of or coast through.
figures.text: A course you can actually get into, actually afford, and actually stay motivated through for 3-5 years usually out-earns a prestige pick you drop out of or coast through.

supporting: A Rs 30 LPA BTech offer and a Rs 4 LPA BTech offer can come from the same course title at different colleges. Always check which tier of institute a salary figure is describing before you compare it to another course.

blocks.heading: Four Questions Before You Pick One Course

figures.label: Total Course Duration
figures.source: Do you want desk-and-screen work (software, CA, design), people-facing work (nursing, hospitality, law court work), or site-based work (architecture, civil)? A 3-5 year degree commits you to a daily rhythm, not just a subject.
